method: Actual core inline Supervisor vs selected backend (integrated uses the full opt-in Supervisor, durable uses the benchmark prototype). Same deterministic 3-message cycles, 4 KiB tool results, unique persisted request/tool IDs; every 100 cycles compact to last 10 cycles. Native fixture includes one indexed terminal submission per historical user request. Fresh processes, warm filesystem caches, 1 unmeasured warmup per fixture. Imports/fixture construction excluded from elapsed; OS peak includes imports. GC 3 times before/after. Timing includes open + active context/status. Full canonical history hash and duplicate oldest/middle/latest request checks happen after snapshots. SQLite FULL vs fsynced JSONL. No model or tool calls; no PG, RPC, multi-agent or migration-import timing.
